title: Register Convention: The Valuation an Issued Credit Rests On
content:
The figure a credit issued under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes rests on is ordinarily the price the piece originally sold for. Where the registration's own entries carry a valuation of the piece, the convention below governs, and it turns as well on whether the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register carries a report on the piece issued within the programme's appraisal validity window.

## The convention

- Where the registration's entries carry a valuation of the piece and the appraisal register carries a report on the piece issued within the programme's appraisal validity window, the credit rests on the highest valuation those entries carry.
- Where the entries carry a valuation of the piece but the register carries no report on it issued within that window, the credit rests on the lower of the highest valuation those entries carry and the price the piece originally sold for.
- Where the entries carry no valuation of the piece, the credit rests on the price the piece originally sold for.

A valuation among the registration's entries is a valuation entry recorded against the registration. The report's age is counted in calendar days from the date the register's issued report for the piece was signed to the handling date, and it is within the window while that count does not exceed the window.

## The window by programme

| Programme | Appraisal validity window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 180 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 180 |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

A piece that originally sold for 10000 USD, whose registration carries valuation entries of 9200 and 11500 USD, under a programme whose window is 365 calendar days.

- The register's issued report is 100 days old: the credit rests on 11500 USD.
- The register's issued report is 500 days old: the credit rests on the lower of 11500 and 10000, which is 10000 USD.
- The registration carries no valuation entry at all: the credit rests on 10000 USD.
